source: RFC 5869 appendix A test case 1 plus vectors derived from the protocol constants; all byte fields are lowercase hex

contract.hkdf: HKDF-SHA256 (RFC 5869), extract-then-expand, salt and info as given

sessionKeys.ikm: deviceKey (32 B); the pairing secret S (32 B) during relay pairing

pairingBlobKey.ikm: UTF-8 of the 6-char code as displayed (uppercase)
pairingBlobKey.salt: 16 B from the PC, sent in the session

contract.tunnelNonce: 12 bytes = directionId (uint32 big-endian: 1 = app→pc, 2 = pc→app) || counter (uint64 big-endian, starts at 0, +1 per frame, never reused under one key)
contract.tunnelFrameOnWire: Send(byte[]) payload = counter (8 B big-endian) || ciphertext || tag; receiver rebuilds the nonce from its direction id + the counter and rejects counter <= last accepted
contract.tunnelPlaintext: deflate(SYNC_FLUSH) stream chunk of: streamId (uint16 big-endian) || flag (uint8: 0 data, 1 open, 2 close) || payload
contract.envelope: env / envR / blob = base64url(nonce(12 B, random) || ciphertext || tag), no padding
contract.codeHash: sha256(UTF-8 code) as 64 lowercase hex chars

hkdf.name: session_keys
hkdf.note: ikm = deviceKey (or pairing secret S during relay pairing); salt = nonceA || nonceB; okm[0..32] = k_app2pc, [32..64] = k_pc2app, [64..96] = spare_app2pc, [96..128] = spare_pc2app

aesGcm.name: tunnel_app2pc_16B
aesGcm.note: nonce = dirId 0x00000001 (app→pc) || counter big-endian; counter = plaintext size here for variety; aad empty

aesGcm.name: env_under_deviceKey
aesGcm.note: env = base64url(nonce(12) || ciphertext || tag); nonce random per envelope; key = deviceKey (or S when pairing)
